profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Guild
profile.summary: I am an inquisitive and determined software engineer with experience in full stack and native development. I am passionate about learning new technologies and enjoy working with modern frameworks to develop simple solutions to complex problems. I graduated from Southern New Hampshire University with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science degree. I am currently working as a full stack engineer with tools like Svelte, GraphQL, Storybook, Tailwind, JavaScript, TypeScript, Ruby, Hanami, Redis, RSpec, and PostgreSQL.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Engineered extensive video/audio recording, notetaking, notification, payment, user account, and scheduling features on both the frontend and backend
• Coordinated collaboration efforts throughout the engineering team via technical
discussions, substantive PR reviews, mentorship, feedback, and documentation
• Partnered with cross-functional teams to ensure we’re solving the right problems
in the best way possible and constantly iterating
• Constructed robust backend using Ruby, Hanami, Redis, RSpec, PostgreSQL, and GraphQL with an emphasis on automated testing
• Assembled sleek front end with TypeScript, Svelte, Tailwind, Apollo GraphQL, and Storybook
• Implemented numerous APIs, such as Stripe, PayPal, Mux, Discord, Twitch, Algolia, Customer.io, Shotstack, and Sendbird

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead integration of comprehensive billing, user account, profile, and scheduling features across the stack
• Built out thorough Nest.js API and PostgreSQL database for thousands of users
• Developed responsive frontend with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Styled Components, and more
• Directed state management overhaul across the application with Redux Toolkit and Redux Sagas

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed livestreaming web app with TypeScript, React, and Redux, garnering tens of thousands of visits per day
• Conceptualized and built out extensive Nest.js API and PostgreSQL database
• Incorporated custom real-time chat written in Go
• Integrated OAuth for Google, Twitch, Twitter, Reddit, and Discord
• Implemented Twitch, YouTube, and PayPal APIs for livestreaming integration and billing
• Coordinated small development team using agile methodologies

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: Rock Hill, South Carolina, United States
positions.description:
• Built Python applications to locate inventory, generating over $100,000 in revenue 
• Automated listing process to sites like eBay and Amazon, resulting in over 2,000 sales
• Established MySQL database housing data for thousands of customers and purchases

educations.fieldOfStudy: Information Technology with a concentration in Software Development

honors.title: Distinguished Scholar Award, Computer Science
honors.description: I received the SNHU Distinguished Scholar Award for computer science upon graduating as the top student in the program.
honors.issuer: Issued by Southern New Hampshire University · Apr 2021
